home.heroDescription: A search-first utility dashboard for health, finance, wellness, and content workflows. Public calculators stay usable without signup.

calculator.inputsDescription: Calculators stay free and private. Results run in your browser and basic use never requires an account.
calculator.howItWorksBody: This page uses the migrated pure formula engine for {title}. Inputs are validated before a result is shown, and the formula stays independent from account, billing, and network state so search engines can crawl the public page cleanly.

ai.workspaceBody: Content repurposing, brand voice, history, and analytics in one place.
ai.workspaceCardBody: AI generation is free during v1. Save drafts locally and track recent activity.
ai.directoryDescription: Repurpose content, manage brand voice, and track performance across platforms.
ai.featuredInputSourcesBody: Paste text or drop in a URL — the repurposer pulls the key points.
ai.featuredOutputControlsBody: Pick platforms, tone, brand voice, and model before you generate.
ai.featuredWorkspaceMemoryBody: History and saved drafts stay organized per workspace.
ai.repurposeBody: Turn one source into platform-native drafts for social, newsletters, articles, and community launches. Canceling preserves partial output.
ai.authGateHeading: Sign in to use AI Content Repurposer
ai.authGateBody: AI generation, history, and brand voices live in your workspace. Public calculators stay free and do not use this gate.
ai.analyticsBody: Track usage, generated outputs, credits, platform mix, tone mix, and recent workspace activity.
ai.brandVoiceBody: Create, edit, delete, assign, and preview reusable voices for consistent AI output across workspaces.
ai.historyBody: Search previous AI jobs, filter by status, platform, date, and tone, then reopen details for copy or regeneration.
ai.settingsBody: Manage profile, workspace, API keys, notifications, data export, and destructive account actions.
ai.sectionProfileCopy: Name, email, timezone, and workspace role.
ai.sectionWorkspaceCopy: Team name, default model, brand defaults, and permissions.
ai.sectionApiKeysCopy: Provider keys and workspace-level secret management.
ai.sectionNotificationsCopy: Generation activity and weekly digest preferences.
ai.sectionDataExportCopy: Export your workspace data or transfer ownership.
ai.sectionDangerZoneCopy: Close workspace and remove stored content.
ai.templatesBody: Reusable content workflows for social launches, long-form articles, newsletters, and community posts.
